comparison_rule: Only fresh c1 at 220 W and same multi-page document schedule is the speed baseline; historical 180 W single-page results are not speed baselines.
resource_scope: Exact sum of completed document parse plus FULL Markdown intervals, excluding initialization/export/extra p62 for original_14. Whole GPU measures include shared GLM/TTS; experiment-owned process measurements are separate.
sampling_limits: Sample means are unweighted valid-sample means. Energy interpolates bracketing GPU samples; process pmon may represent its own preceding sampling interval, so component boundary assignment has sampling-scale uncertainty.
